title: Understanding Blockchain in 60 Seconds
description: Crypto/blockchain explainer with high quality, GPU rendering, and voicebox preset. Quick-paced with kinetic text and vibrant grading for social media engagement.
script:
Blockchain is more than just cryptocurrency. [Visual: blockchain network digital nodes] [Transition: fade] [Grade: vivid] [Kinetic: on]
It's a decentralized ledger that no single entity controls. [Visual: decentralized network globe] [Transition: slide] [Grade: cool]
Every transaction is permanently recorded and verifiable. [Visual: digital transaction verified] [Transition: fade] [Kinetic: on]
Smart contracts execute automatically when conditions are met. [Visual: smart contract code digital] [Transition: slide] [Grade: vivid]
Supply chains use blockchain for complete transparency. [Visual: supply chain tracking digital map] [Transition: fade] [Grade: cool]
NFTs proved digital ownership is valuable. [Visual: digital art NFT gallery] [Transition: zoomblur]
Decentralized finance is banking without banks. [Visual: DeFi dashboard crypto finance] [Transition: slide] [Grade: vivid] [Kinetic: on]
The future of trust is decentralized. [Visual: futuristic blockchain city] [Transition: fade] [Grade: cinematic]
